newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa to work with France Air Littoral.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa to work with France Air Littoral.

text.p: German airline Deutsche Lufthansa AG said on Thursday that it would cooperate with French carrier Air Littoral, offering passengers joint flights to destinations in France, Italy and Spain.
In a mandatory bourse statement, Lufthansa said "Air Littoral is a new cooperation partner for Lufthansa."
A contract will be signed in Paris on Thursday, Lufthansa said, adding however that its own supervisory board still needed to approve the plans.
Lufthansa and Air Littoral will operate under a code-sharing agreement to 26 destinations in France, Italy and Spain, Lufthansa said.
"Close cooperation is also envisioned in marketing, sales, customer service, ground service, airline service and cargo services," Lufthansa said.
